THE TIDE BEACON

Moonlit Cove: four palette colour cycles animate one static 320 by 180 PNG backdrop and a hand lantern at 60 Hz, while world state stays discrete.

Loading the engine...

Play

Point at the waterfall, tide pool, or iron brazier to highlight it. Use Look to examine each feature, Use on the brazier to stoke the signal flame, and Walk to move between the wooden pier and the rocky ledge. Press S to step through the short walkthrough.

Colour cycling

One static 320 by 180 PNG backdrop and one inline 16 by 24 Keeper sprite carry all four animations through palette rotation: waterfall foam (6 colours every 5 frames), ocean surf (6 colours every 7 frames), brazier embers and lantern flame (5 colours every 4 frames), and twinkling stars (4 colours every 14 frames).

How it works in BeSpoke

The script declares cycle lines over its palette: entries. Cycles live in the optional CYCL package section, run on the 60 Hz display clock, and write zero world facts, so pausing ticks with Space, scrubbing, or rewinding keeps simulation state deterministic.

cycle "w1" "w2" "w3" "w4" "w5" "w6" every 5
cycle "o1" "o2" "o3" "o4" "o5" "o6" every 7
cycle "f1" "f2" "f3" "f4" "f5" every 4
cycle "t1" "t2" "t3" "t4" every 14

Keys

  • Enter, Space, or click: next message
  • Space: pause simulation ticks while colour cycles keep animating
  • S: play the next step for you
  • Right-click: next verb
  • R: rewind to tick 0
  • I: state inspector (facts as a graph)
Runs entirely in your browser on the BeSpoke Engine, a simulation engine for systemic and narrative games. The whole game is in this one file; nothing is downloaded or tracked.
